# E0341: a lens maps a field its target version does not declare

A mapping produces a field its target version does not declare. A lens writes
only what its target declares, however open the author wrote the schema.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	a: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
schema: {
	b: string
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		b:    v0_0.a
		nope: v0_0.a
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0341]: 1.0 does not declare nope
 --> 1.0.thema:9:3
  |
9 |         nope: v0_0.a
  |         ^^^^
  |
```
